findings.explanation: Multiple UI deletion/archive operations may leave multiple same-named live notifications; helper required globally unique feedback.
findings.resolution: Feedback presence accepts repeated visible statuses. Actual Undo/Dismiss action selection remains strict when exercised.

findings.validation: Task-specific positive/negative contracts; TypeScript passed; browser result recorded by parent

findings.explanation: Strict locator OR rejected coexisting optional confirmation and already-empty collection.
findings.resolution: Poll two public outcomes as booleans, confirm when shown, then assert empty named collection.
findings.validation: Task-specific positive/negative contracts; TypeScript passed; browser result recorded by parent

findings.explanation: Color tests only checked the renamed action although Then explicitly says that is insufficient.
findings.resolution: Connect the already existing rendered-pixel light-green surface oracle to both color scenarios; keep title/content/action/reload checks.
findings.validation: Task-specific positive/negative contracts; TypeScript passed; browser result recorded by parent

findings.explanation: List view enforced left edges within 3 pixels, rejecting valid single-column centered/different-width cards.
findings.resolution: Require shared vertical line through surfaces and pairwise vertical separation, keeping multiple-column grid check and state/content checks.
findings.validation: Task-specific positive/negative contracts; TypeScript passed; browser result recorded by parent

findings.explanation: Each matching fragment may occur more than once, but one global matching highlight locator had to be unique.
findings.resolution: Require at least one visible named fragment and check every visible fragment against the exact keyword, preserving the scoped note identity.

findings.explanation: Removed plain-text content/labels were counted even in retained hidden markup.
findings.resolution: Only visible obsolete text must be absent, preserving saved-state and later filter/reload checks.
findings.validation: Task-specific positive/negative contracts; TypeScript passed; browser result recorded by parent

findings.explanation: Broader prose obligations are not fully exercised: keyboard-accessible hover actions; icon uniqueness; visual emphasis of keyword regions; reload durability of Undo transitions; Save/Cancel behavior for the second checkbox.
findings.resolution: Keep these as coverage gaps rather than infer behavior from roles, feedback, or the scenario denominator. No new scenario IDs were invented.
findings.validation: Static source review; explicitly not closed

findings.explanation: Normalized DOM text may disagree with visible multiline content rendered as adjacent block nodes; clipped screen-reader-only sidebar text can also differ from Playwright text visibility.
findings.resolution: Source semantics retained; no arbitrary CSS fallback or content-internal access added. These representation cases require further independent implementations/probes.
findings.validation: Static source review; explicitly not closed

findings.explanation: Empty Trash currently counts nested region roles as note regions; an unspecified auxiliary named region inside Deleted notes could be rejected.
findings.resolution: Do not pretend region role alone uniquely distinguishes arbitrary note/auxiliary objects. Existing explicit note-region contract remains; further public identity disambiguation is needed for such auxiliary layouts.
findings.validation: Static source review; explicitly not closed

findings.explanation: A matching note elsewhere on the page could satisfy a required Trash/Archived collection member while the named collection was empty.
findings.resolution: Bind each positive Trash/Archived result to the existing named collection and exact note identity, retaining content and global uniqueness checks.
findings.validation: Positive in-collection member and matching out-of-collection preview negative contract added.

limitations: Source review and targeted contract probes do not establish measured real-application false-negative rates or all 33 business passes.
Existing explicit role/name contracts remain derivative benchmark conventions. No new ARIA structure or source semantics introduced.
Broader keyboard, icon, highlight visual emphasis, Undo reload and second-setting behavior are not fully tested.
Multiline DOM text, clipped accessible labels and auxiliary regions in an empty collection retain explicitly documented representation risks.
The existing broad light-green pixel threshold is a bounded visual oracle; it is not screenshot similarity or proof that every human-recognized light-green shade is accepted.

validation.typecheck: All Keep spec/helper/fixture/visual files plus new contract spec passed TypeScript; no controller source changed, so no controller full suite run.
validation.browser: Parent execution initial 17-case run identified two zero-area empty collection false negatives. Those are fixed without adding padding. Current suite has 21 cases, including hidden/duplicate collection and collection-membership counterexamples; final parent result authoritative.
